scenario: Discussing weekend plans with a friend
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika sana kusema kuhusu nia au mipango.
Pia hutumika kutoa maoni au mapendekezo.
Hutumika na 'to' kutoa maana ya kuelekea mahali au kufanya jambo fulani.
Hutuma maana ya nia au azimio.
Hutuma maana ya ushirika au ala.
Katika mazingatio, hutumika kusema kuhusu upatikanaji.
Kutoa maana ya kushangaza au ubora.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you have any plans for the weekend?
dialogue.translation: Je, una mpango wowote kwa mwisho wa wiki?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think I want to go to the beach, but maybe it will be too crowded.
dialogue.translation: Nafikiri nina taka kwenda kwenye uwanja wa mvua, lakini labda utakuwa na watu wengi sana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea! But do you have time to go with me?
dialogue.translation: Fikra njema! Lakini, je, una wakati kwenda nami?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I have time because I finished my work early.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, nina wakati kwa sababu nimeamaliza kazi yangu mapema.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect! I think it will be a good weekend.
dialogue.translation: Kamilifu! Nafikiri utakuwa mwisho wa wiki wa kipekee.

scenario: Returning a faulty item at a shop
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I bought this phone here, but it doesn't work.
dialogue.translation: Habari, nimenunua simu hii hapa, lakini haikaziki.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. How long ago did you buy it?
dialogue.translation: Samahani kuhusu hayo. Umenunua lini kabla?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Only two days ago. I want a new one, if possible.
dialogue.translation: Siku mbili tu iliyopita. Natafuta moja mpya, kama inaweza.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Take this form and fill it out. After that, I can give you a replacement.
dialogue.translation: Bilazima. Chukua fomu hii na jaza. Baada ya hapo, naweza kukupa mabadiliko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. So I give you the faulty phone back, and I get a new one?
dialogue.translation: Asante. Hivyo ninakurudisha simu isiyotoweka, na napata moja mpya?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. And if you need more help, just ask me.
dialogue.translation: Ndio hivyo. Na kama unahitaji msaada zaidi, tuuliza.

scenario: Booking a table at a restaurant by phone
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Katika mazingira ya mkahawa, ina maana ya meza iliyohifadhiwa.
Inatumika katika maswali kwa 'kuwa na uwezo'.
Maana yake ni 'inapatikana' katika mazingira haya.
Inatamaniwa jina kwa ajili ya uhifadhi.
Inatumika katika 'chini ya jina' (kwa jina la).

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I need to book a table for tonight.
dialogue.translation: Habari, ninahitaji kuhifadhi meza kwa usiku huu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. For how many people?
dialogue.translation: Bilazima. Kwa watu wapi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: For four people, please.
dialogue.translation: Kwa watu wawili, tafadhali.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: We have a free table at 8 o'clock. Is that okay?
dialogue.translation: Tuna meza huru saa moja. Je, ni sawa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, that's fine. I'll call back to confirm later.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, ni sawa. Nitawasiliana tena kuthibitisha baadaye.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great. Can I have your name for the reservation?
dialogue.translation: Nzuri. Naweza kupata jina lako kwa ajili ya uhifadhi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, it's under the name García.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, ni chini ya jina la García.

scenario: Describing symptoms at a pharmacy
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa kuelezea jinsi unavyojisikia kimwili au hisia.
Hutoa mwanzo wa kipindi cha muda.
Kijengeleza kiinua nguvu za vituo au kilele cha kiburi.
Hutumiwa na majina yasiyo hesabiwa au kuhariri vitendo.
Hutokana na mtu au jambo tofauti.
Kilinganifu au kutoa sehemu kubwa zaidi.
Hutoa utendaji wa vitendo kwa pamoja.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I feel very bad since yesterday.
dialogue.translation: Nimejisikia vibaya sana tangu jana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What do you have?
dialogue.translation: Una na nini?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: My head hurts, and I still have a lot of pain.
dialogue.translation: Kichwa changu kinapumzika, na bado nina maumivu mengi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Do you have any other symptoms?
dialogue.translation: Je, una alama zingine?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I also feel tired most of the day.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, pia ninajisikia chini kwa muda mrefu wa siku.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Take this medicine while you are here, and you will feel better soon.
dialogue.translation: Twaa dawa hii wakati wa hapa, na utajisikia vizuri zaidi hivi karibuni.

scenario: Talking about your hometown to a visitor
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kushiriki vyombo vyote katika kikundi.
Fili isiyo na mabadiliko: walk - walked - walked.
Kuelezea umri au umri wa kitu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Welcome to my hometown! It's a small place, but I love it.
dialogue.translation: Karibu katika mjini wa kiziwi wangu! Ni sehemu kidogo, lakini ninapenda.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks! Where do you live exactly?
dialogue.translation: Asante! Unakaa wapi hasa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I live near the old church. It's very beautiful.
dialogue.translation: Nikaa karibu na kanisa la zamani. Ni nzuri sana.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, nice! Is there a market every day?
dialogue.translation: Oh, nzuri! Kuna soko kila siku?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, and I walk there every morning to buy fresh things.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, na ninatembea huko kila asubuhi kunuza mambo ya kisasa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds lovely. Then we can go together tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Inaonekana nzuri. Halifu tunaweza kwenda pamoja kesho?

scenario: Changing a reservation at a hotel
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inaweza kuwa ya chumba, meza, na kadiri ya hiyo.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I need to change my reservation for a different day.
dialogue.translation: Habari, ninahitaji kubadilisha hifadhi yangu kwa siku tofauti.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. Do you want to come earlier or later?
dialogue.translation: Bilazima. Unataka kuja mapema au mbali?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Later, please. Is a room available for next week?
dialogue.translation: Mbali, tafadhali. Je, kuna chumba kinachopatikana wiki ijayo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let me check. We have another room free after Monday.
dialogue.translation: Nipe nichakie. Tuna chumba kingine huru baada ya Jumatatu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can I change my reservation to that day?
dialogue.translation: Bora. Naweza kubadilisha hifadhi yangu kwa siku hiyo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but you must confirm before Friday.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, lakini unapaswa kuthibitisha kabla ya Ijumaa.

scenario: Asking for advice on what to buy
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Jina la kiungo, haustahiliwa katika jamii
Hutumiwa katika maelezo; katika maswali/ukatazito hutumiwa 'anything'
Jina la kiungo; inasemiwa 'a piece of advice'
Hutumiwa na kitu cha kawaida au na 'that'

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I want to buy something for my brother, but I don't have much money.
dialogue.translation: Nataka kununua kitu chochote kwa ndugu yangu, lakini sina pesa nyingi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What's the price range? Something cheap or expensive?
dialogue.translation: Ni sehemu gani ya bei? Kitu chochote ki rkhis au ki ghali?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Cheap, please. Can you recommend a good gift for a buyer like me?
dialogue.translation: Ki rkhis, tafadhali. Unaweza kuniwasilisha zawadi njema kwa mnunua kama mimi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. I advise you to choose a nice mug or a book.
dialogue.translation: Bilashaka. Ninakushirikisha kuchagua kikombe cha kipekee au kitabu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great! I'll take your advice and choose the mug.
dialogue.translation: Nzuri! Nitakubali ushirikiano wako na kuchagua kikombe.

scenario: Talking about past holidays
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did you go anywhere last year?
dialogue.translation: Je, ulienda mahali wowote mwaka uliopita?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I went to the beach. The weather was really good there.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, nilienda kwenye kiwanja cha mvua. Hali ya hewa ilikuwa nzuri sana huko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. Did you get time to relax?
dialogue.translation: Inasikiliza vizuri. Je, ulipata wakati wa kupumzika?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, because it was very quiet. I loved it.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, kwa sababu ilikuwa wenye utulivu sana. Nimeipenda.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great. Did you come back tired?
dialogue.translation: Nzuri. Je, ulirudi ukijua umetoka?

scenario: Discussing what you did last weekend
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika na mfano wa kituo cha kusudi: visit my family.

vocabulary.translation: nje, kutoka (katika maneno kama 'eat out' = kula nje)

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi! What did you do this weekend?
dialogue.translation: Habari! Ulitenda nini mwisho wa wiki huu?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I visited my grandparents and stayed at their house.
dialogue.translation: Niliwendea wazazi wa mama yangu na nikakaa nyumbani mwao.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Nice! Did you enjoy it?
dialogue.translation: Nzuri! Ulikufurahia?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we watched a movie together on Saturday.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, tulitazama filamu pamoja siku ya Jumamosi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds great. Did you go out to eat?
dialogue.translation: Inasikiwa vizuri. Mlikwenda nje kula?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, because we cooked at home. It was very relaxing.
dialogue.translation: Hapana, kwa sababu tulipika nyumbani. Ilikuwa yenye kutoa furaha.

key_phrases.phrase: What did you do this weekend?
key_phrases.translation: Ulitenda nini mwisho wa wiki huu?

scenario: Planning a birthday party
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kuweka mikakati ya kufanya jambo fulani kabla.
Kula inayotolewa katika sherehe za kuzaliwa.
Inatumika kuweka swali kuhusu njia au mbinu.
Inatumika kuweka swali au kuhusu muda.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We need to plan the party for Ana's birthday. How many people should we invite?
dialogue.translation: Tunahitaji kuweka mikakati ya sherehe ya kuzaliwa kwa Ana. Watu wengine ni wapi ambao tunapaswa kuwaita?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I have an idea: let's invite about ten friends. When is the party going to be?
dialogue.translation: Nina fikra: tuwaite rafiki kumi. Lini sherehe hiyo itakuwa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: On Saturday afternoon. We also need a big cake for everyone.
dialogue.translation: Juma moja mchana. Pia tunahitaji keki kubwa kwa kila mmoja.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Good. I can make the cake, and we can play a fun game outside.
dialogue.translation: Nzuri. Mimi ninaweza kutengeneza keki, na tunaweza kucheza mchezo wa kufurahisha nje.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds perfect. Now we only need to buy the decorations.
dialogue.translation: Inaonekana vizuri. Sasa tunahitaji kununua zavu tu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Great, we have a plan! When you go, remember to get some balloons too.
dialogue.translation: Nzuri, tumepewa mikakati! Lini unapokwenda, kumbuka kununua mapambo pia.

scenario: Asking about public transport routes
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kutoa taarifa kuhusu nchi ya usafiri inayotumika.
Inaonyesha asili au mahali pa kutoka.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, how can I take a bus to the museum?
dialogue.translation: Samahani, jinsi gani naweza kupata basi kwenda kwenye makumbusho?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Take the number 5 bus from the stop here, and then get off at the next stop.
dialogue.translation: Chukua basi la nambari 5 kutoka kituo hapa, na halafu shuka katika kituo kijacho.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is it far from here?
dialogue.translation: Je, ni mbali kutoka hapa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it's not far. After you get off, walk left for two minutes, and the museum is on your right.
dialogue.translation: Hapana, si mbali. Baada ya kushuka, nenda kushota kwa dakika mbili, na makumbusho yatakuwa upande wako wa kulia.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great, so I take the bus and then walk a little. Thank you!
dialogue.translation: Nzuri, hivyo nachukua basi na halafu nainua kidogo. Asante!

scenario: Talking about your job to someone new
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kusema kuhusu ajira yako au kazi unayofanya.
Kazi unayofanya au nafasi ya ajira.
Kipimo cha muda; mara nyingi hutumika jamla kusema kuhusu muda wa kazi.
Kukomalisha au kufanya kazi iwe tayari.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hi! I'm Mark. What do you do?
dialogue.translation: Habari! Ninaitwa Mark. Unafanya nini?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I work at a small company. My job is interesting, but sometimes it's hard.
dialogue.translation: Ninafanya kazi katika kampuni kidogo. Kazi yangu ni ya kufurahisha, lakini mara nyingi ni ngumu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. What are your hours?
dialogue.translation: Nafahamu. Ni zipi masaa yako?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I start at nine and finish at five. I often work late on Fridays.
dialogue.translation: Ninaanza saa 9 na nikimaliza saa 5. Mara nyingi ninafanya kazi hadi kwa usiku Ijumaa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's not too bad. Tell me more about your company.
dialogue.translation: Sio mbaya sana. Niambie zaidi kuhusu kampuni yako.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. We make software for schools. It's a good place to work.
dialogue.translation: Ndio. Tunafanya programi za kompyuta za shule. Ni sehemu njema ya kufanya kazi.

key_phrases.phrase: I start at nine and finish at five.

scenario: Describing your home and neighborhood
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kutoa taarifa kuhusu eneo la kuwaka.
Kivuli cha kina cha kusifu umbali.
Mbinu inayofanyika na makazi mengi au nyumba za kupangwa.
Inatumika katika sehemu ambazo hazina sauti.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Where do you live?
dialogue.translation: Unakaa wapi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I live in a small building on the fifth floor. It's very quiet here.
dialogue.translation: Nikaa katika nyumba kidogo kwenye sakafu ya tano. Hapa ni kimya sana.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. Is there a park near your street?
dialogue.translation: Inasikiliza vizuri. Kuna ustani karibu na mtaa wako?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, there's a big park just two blocks away. But it's always crowded on weekends.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, kuna ustani mkubwa umbali wa makuta mawili tu. Lakini inaongezeka wakati wa mwisho wa wiki.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. My apartment is small too, but it's near a quiet street.
dialogue.translation: Nimeelewa. Nyumba yangu pia ni kidogo, lakini inakaribia mtaa ulio na kimya.

key_phrases.translation: inaongezeka wakati wa mwisho wa wiki

scenario: Making plans for the next day
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Kwa ajili ya kutana na mtu.
Kwa kawaida, lakini kulikuwa kwenye orodha ya kutengenezwa.
Ingawa ina kwenye orodha ya kutengenezwa, ni muhimu kwa ajili ya utulivu; hutumiwa katika makusanyiko.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to do in the morning tomorrow?
dialogue.translation: Unataka kufanya nini asubuhi kesho?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I don't know. Maybe we can meet at the usual place before 9?
dialogue.translation: Sijui. Labda tunaweza kutana kwenye mahali ya kawaida kabla ya saa 9?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's early for me, but I can call you later to confirm.
dialogue.translation: Hiyo ni mapema kwangu, lakini naweza kukuza baadaye ili kuthibitisha.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Okay, but don't call too late because I go to sleep early.
dialogue.translation: Sawa, lakini usinipigie simu visa kwa sababu ninamwendea kulala mapema.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure, I'll call before 8. Then we can have a good day.
dialogue.translation: Ndio, nitakukuza kabla ya saa 8. Baadaye tunaweza kuwa na siku njema.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Perfect. I'm sure it will be a nice day.
dialogue.translation: Kamilifu. Ninaweka imani kwamba itakuwa siku njema.

scenario: Complaining politely about a problem
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inayotumika kwa ujumla kuelezea changamoto au tatizo.
Inayochambua kitu ambacho haipo sawa au kinachoshindwa.
Katika mazingira ya vyombo, maana yake ni kuwasha au kufanya kazi.
Inayotumika na vitendo kama 'turn off' kuelezea kufunga.
Kitenzi muhimu kuelezea utambuzi au ukosefu wake.
Kitenzi kinachotumika sana; hapa maana yake ni kufanya au kutoa.
Inayotumika kuweka uzuri kwa uburuji au shikwa.
Inayotumika katika ukatili au maswali kuelezea kwamba jambo fulani halijatokea.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I have a problem with my room. The TV doesn't turn on.
dialogue.translation: Samahani, nina tatizo chumbani mwangu. TV hauwashi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Is it completely off?
dialogue.translation: Nina huzuni kukuwa na habari hiyo. Imezima kabisa?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I tried, but it doesn't work. I really don't understand why.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, nimejaribu, lakini haifanyi kazi. Sikielewa kwa nini.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe there is a wrong connection. Let me check. I'll make it work soon.
dialogue.translation: Labda kuna uhusiano ulio na tatizo. Nichoeleze. Nitafanya iendelee kazi karibu tu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thank you. I haven't watched anything yet, so I hope you can fix it now.
dialogue.translation: Asante. Sijawa kuwata tamasha chochote bado, hivyo natumaini unaweza kufikia sasa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Of course. I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I'll check it right away.
dialogue.translation: Bilazima. Nina huzuni kwa ubaya. Nitachunguza mara moja.

key_phrases.translation: Nina huzuni kukuwa na habari hiyo.

scenario: Talking about a recent film or book
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Inatumika kwa filamu na miradi ya TV.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I watched a new film last night. It was very good!
dialogue.translation: Niliongea filamu mpya usiku uliopita. Ilikuwa nzuri sana!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh really? What's the story about?
dialogue.translation: Kweli? Ni kuhusu nini hadithi hiyo?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's about a man who travels back in time. But the end is a bit strange.
dialogue.translation: Inahusu mtu aliyekuwa akirejea nyuma katika muda. Lakini mwisho ni kidogo ajabu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. I only read the book, not the film.
dialogue.translation: Inasikiliza kama kitu chenye kushangaza. Nimeosoma kitabu pekee, si filamu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The film is better than the book, I think. But then I haven't read it.
dialogue.translation: Filamu ni bora zaidi kuliko kitabu, nayo ni maana. Lakini halifu sijasoma.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: After I finish my exams, I'll watch it. Thanks for the recommendation!
dialogue.translation: Baada ya kufanya mtihani wangu, nitaitazama. Asante kwa ushirikiano wako!

key_phrases.phrase: The end is a bit strange

scenario: At a job interview (basic)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: ina maana ujaribu wa kazi au maisha

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning. I have a few questions for you. First, why do you want this job?
dialogue.translation: Habari za asubuhi. Nina maswali machache kwa ajili yako. Kwanza, unataka kazi hii kwa nini?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I really like working with people, and I have some experience in customer service.
dialogue.translation: Ninapenda sana kufanya kazi na watu, na muna uzoefu katika huduma ya wateja.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. Also, can you work on weekends?
dialogue.translation: Nimeelewa. Pia, unaweza kufanya kazi mwishoweekendi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that is possible. I can work on Saturdays and Sundays.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, ni imkanu. Naweza kufanya kazi Jumamosi na Jumapili.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good. When can you start?
dialogue.translation: Nzuri. Unaweza kuanza lini?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I can start next week because I need to give notice at my current job.
dialogue.translation: Naweza kuanza wiki ijayo kwa sababu hitaji kutoa taarifa kazini yangu sasa.

scenario: Discussing food preferences at dinner
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Fiili isiyostahili msingi: eat / ate / eaten
Neno la kawaida kwa kila kitu unachokula
Kuelezea tamanni; mara nyingi inafuatwa na kiinfiniti
Inatumika katika habari za kishikamana na majina ya kushuka au ya kadhaa
Neno la kawaida kwa kitu au mawazo
Katika mazingira haya maana yake ni 'pia' mwisho wa habari

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?
dialogue.translation: Unataka kula nini kwa ajili ya chakula cha jioni?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: Ninapenda mifuo, lakini sina takwa kitu cha kina leo usiku.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.
dialogue.translation: Tuna baadhi ya kuku na mboga kwenye friji. Hivyo inaweza kuwa nzuri.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I really want something with more flavor.
dialogue.translation: Inasikiliza vizuri. Lakini kweli nina takwa kitu chenye tamani zaidi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about we make a stir-fry with some rice?
dialogue.translation: Je, tutafanya kukaanga na baadhi ya mchele?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a good idea. So we can eat it together, and I can help you cook too.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, ni mawazo mema. Hivyo tunaweza kula pamoja, na pia ninaweza kukusaidia kupika.

scenario: Asking for help with a computer issue
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Hutumiwa kotoa msaada kwa njia ya kushangaza.
Fahamu la kutoa au kotoa msaada.
Katika mazingira ya mashine au kompyuta.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could you help me? I need to use my computer, but the screen is black.
dialogue.translation: Ungaweza kuniusaidia? Nina hitaji kutumia kompyuta yangu, lakini skrini ina kiudu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me see. Did you click the right button?
dialogue.translation: Ndio. Acha niangalie. Je, ulichukua klik kitufe cha sahihi?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But it doesn't work. Maybe it's broken.
dialogue.translation: Ndio, nilifanya. Lakini haifanyi kazi. Labda imevunjika.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's try again. Sometimes it works after a few minutes.
dialogue.translation: Tujaribu tena. Mara nyingine hufanya kazi baada ya dakika michache.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait. But, because it's urgent, I need it now.
dialogue.translation: Sawa, nitawaita. Lakini, kwa sababu ni ya haraka, nina hitaji sasa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see. Let me check the power button. Ah, here! Now it works!
dialogue.translation: Ninaelewa. Acha niangalie kitufe cha nguvu. Ah, hapa! Sasa hufanya kazi!

scenario: Renting an apartment (first inquiry)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Katika Kiingereza cha Marekani ni kawaida; katika Kiingereza cha Uingereza husema 'flat'.
Inatumika kwa vitu au mahali ambayo ni huru.
Kipindi cha muda; inafaa kusema kuhusu kodi ya kila mwezi.
Inatumika kusema kitu ambacho kimeingizwa katika bei.
Pia maana yake ni 'ardhi', lakini hapa ni makao ya nyumba.
Kwa kutoa kipindi cha muda au sehemu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?
dialogue.translation: Habari, nataka kukodi nyumba. Inapatikana sasa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.
dialogue.translation: Ndiyo, inapatikana. Kodi ni dola 800 kila mwezi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?
dialogue.translation: Bei hiyo ina jumuisha maji na umeme?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it includes only water. Electricity is extra.
dialogue.translation: Hapana, ina jumuisha maji tu. Umeme ni ziadhuri.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And what floor is it on? Is it near a supermarket?
dialogue.translation: Na ipo kwenye mkazo gani? Inakaribia duka la mall?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the third floor, and it's between two big supermarkets. Maybe you can visit it tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Ipo kwenye mkazo wa tatu, na ina kati ya duka mbili kubwa za mall. Labda unaweza kuwaona kesho.
